groups.group: Master Rules & Part I — Core architecture

rules.title: Mechanical freeze-integrity / coverage gate
rules.equation: structural checker; 9 conditions incl. demonstrated negative control
rules.boundaries: a rule-ID marker alone is not a body
rules.activeInAlkOnlyV2: ACTIVE (applies to this package, not to canon edits)

rules.title: Advisory responsibility, non-adherence, engine-originated risk
rules.equation: three states never collapsed: CONFIRMED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED / UNKNOWN / IMPLEMENTED
rules.boundaries: UNKNOWN never becomes IMPLEMENTED or NOT_IMPLEMENTED without evidence

rules.title: Inform-and-proceed test
rules.output: proceed or withhold only the unsupported output
rules.equation: withhold iff the issue makes the recommendation mathematically/evidentially/physically unsupported
rules.boundaries: "less likely to work" is not "unsupported"

rules.title: Repeated ignored guidance is not a source of controller complexity
rules.equation: design heuristic, NOT a runtime threshold
rules.boundaries: never stop advising after N ignored recommendations

rules.title: Simulated non-adherent keepers are test instruments
rules.equation: classification rule
rules.boundaries: passing does not require rescuing biology

rules.title: Stabilise first: automatic maintenance targets S=0
rules.equation: S_desired = 0; no target-acquisition component
rules.boundaries: symmetric high and low unless an explicit parameter safety exception

rules.title: Latest valid measurement owns current position
rules.equation: position = latest VALID cluster representative value
rules.boundaries: fitted/smoothed/forecast values may never replace it

rules.title: One analytical owner
rules.equation: engine owns position, trajectory, evidence, consumption, potency, maintenance, response, recommendation, next-test timing
rules.boundaries: a second chemistry implementation is a defect even if it matches today

rules.title: Recorded facts preserve timestamps and historical values
Effective-dated configuration
rules.equation: resolve the version effective at assessmentAsOf; never backfill
rules.boundaries: pre-first-proven-version replay is NOT_RUN

rules.title: Derived estimates retain inputs, exclusions, method and confidence
A recommendation is not an implemented action
rules.equation: only a confirmed actual action changes the timeline

rules.title: History answers behavioural questions, not position
rules.output: direction, rate, consistency, consumption, response, potency, forecast
rules.boundaries: position and history may legitimately disagree

rules.title: Fundamental dosing model
rules.equation: S = P D - C ; C = P D - S ; D_maintenance = C / P
rules.boundaries: validity, contemporaneity and support must all hold before use

rules.title: Return plan is opt-in and never silently embedded
rules.boundaries: offering does not alter maintenance

rules.title: Post-intervention position event is orthogonal to response
rules.inputs: latest value, target boundary, intervention direction
rules.boundaries: (EXPECTED, OVERSHOOT) is legal

rules.title: Presentation is derived from domain state
rules.equation: UI branch ordering must not define chemistry

rules.title: Immutable chronological event ledger
rules.equation: every actual dose change creates a new event; never overwrite

rules.title: Confirmed programmed schedule is a first-class basis
rules.equation: mixed interval with no eligible basis -> integration NOT_RUN and segment at the boundary
rules.boundaries: a configured 10 mL/day rate does not mean 10 mL was delivered instantly

rules.title: Clean analytical segments are first-class
rules.equation: ordinary control must not fit one slope across a dose boundary
rules.boundaries: eligibility is per inference

rules.title: Known corrections must not be mistaken for consumption change
rules.equation: actual delivery history; no universal 3-day linear profile
rules.boundaries: unknown corrections confound

rules.title: Exact time drives all rates
rules.equation: dDays = dHours / 24 = dSeconds / 86400
rules.boundaries: never infer elapsed time from date labels

rules.title: Measurement clusters
rules.equation: a repeat cluster must not satisfy an independent-reading requirement

rules.title: Suspicious is not invalid; regime shifts must survive
rules.equation: excluded measurements retain raw value, status, reason, confirmation relationship
rules.boundaries: 8.5,8.5,7.8,repeat 7.82 is a genuine shift; an unusual reading is never silently discarded

rules.title: Trend estimation: Theil-Sen default for 3+ points
rules.output: slope, direction, span, count, uncertainty, residuals, estimator, exclusions, segment
rules.equation: S_TS = median(s_ij)
rules.boundaries: OLS is diagnostic only

rules.title: One Evidence Engine, question-specific thresholds
rules.equation: one explicit owner for evidence rules
rules.boundaries: same dataset may be SUFFICIENT for trend and PROVISIONAL for potency

rules.title: Signal relative to uncertainty
rules.equation: a non-zero slope is not automatically actionable
rules.boundaries: exact thresholds are parameter-specific

rules.title: Consumption is a fast-moving latent variable
rules.equation: recent evidence dominates; old demand must not anchor indefinitely
rules.boundaries: change points allowed

rules.title: Potency is a slow-moving system variable (architecture firewall)
rules.equation: no dose change + changed slope = consumption evidence; controlled dose change + changed slope may be potency evidence

rules.title: Theoretical potency
rules.equation: parameter-specific formulas

rules.title: Effective potency learning
rules.inputs: clean pre/post dose states and slopes
rules.boundaries: learning is passive; never perturb a stable reef

rules.title: Learned potency is effective delivered potency
rules.equation: P_observed = P_chemical x PumpFactor x VolumeFactor x DeliveryFactor
rules.boundaries: must not claim a reservoir concentration is wrong

rules.title: Potency contexts
rules.inputs: tank, parameter, product, batch, pump, volume, delivery config
rules.equation: context changes start a new context
rules.boundaries: historical observations retained

rules.title: One selected potency consumed by the dosing engine
rules.equation: P_selected = P_theoretical before calibration, P_learned after
rules.boundaries: the dosing engine must not re-learn potency

rules.title: Negative / impossible inferred consumption
rules.output: arithmetic result, physical interpretability, recommendation eligibility kept separate
rules.equation: an impossible mass balance must not drive a large dose change
rules.boundaries: never guess a cause

rules.title: Recommendation gating
rules.inputs: quality, evidence, intervention state, response, potency, position, safety, bracket, forecast
rules.equation: a calculated dose is not automatically a recommendation

rules.title: HOLD is a full recommendation
rules.boundaries: never force an action to provide an answer

rules.title: Intervention records
rules.equation: a recommendation alone does not start an intervention

rules.title: Expected response
rules.equation: dS_expected = P (D_new - D_old); S_pred = S_pre + dS_expected

rules.title: Interrupted intervention
rules.equation: never labelled failed or successful
rules.boundaries: normally ineligible for strong potency calibration

rules.title: Anti-chatter / intervention lock
rules.equation: require stronger justification before reversing a recent ordinary decision unless safety requires action
rules.boundaries: overridden only by rapid, safety-bound, obvious dosing failure or confirmed severe contradiction

rules.title: Return plans: destination, opt-in, no ambiguous combined dose
rules.equation: AimPoint = (RangeMin + RangeMax) / 2
rules.boundaries: no separately stored ideal point

rules.title: Forecasting
rules.equation: A(t) = A_now + S t
rules.boundaries: forecasts are estimates, not guarantees

rules.title: Dynamic Retest Scheduler is an engine output
rules.equation: the earliest applicable candidate after the ordinary-observation clamps
rules.fixtures: WG-ALK-060, AD-RET-001, AD-RET-002, AD-RET-003, AD-RET-004, INV-I1

rules.title: Water changes are parameter-specific disturbances
rules.equation: V2 rejects both blanket rules

rules.title: Empirical bracketing is a sanity and conflict detector
rules.equation: not the primary potency learner; conflicts preserved in confidence/audit
rules.boundaries: never silently hidden

rules.title: Safety uses physical effect where possible
rules.equation: EffectChange = |dD| x P_selected; use the strictest applicable constraint
rules.boundaries: 2 mL is not the same intervention on every tank

rules.title: Cross-parameter reasoning is a plausibility layer
rules.equation: must not automatically invalidate a directly supported independent trend
rules.boundaries: stable Alk does not prove falling Ca is not calcification

rules.title: Unit safety
rules.equation: never store a level and a dose in the same field

rules.title: History truthfulness
rules.equation: changing target range, product, potency or algorithm version must not rewrite historical recommendations
rules.boundaries: retrospective re-analysis is a separate new assessment

rules.title: Audit record
rules.equation: 30+ required fields

rules.title: Recommendation confidence
rules.output: UNSPECIFIED plus the underlying evidence facts
rules.equation: no numeric classification exists; UNSPECIFIED is the frozen output
rules.boundaries: a high-confidence recommendation must not be built from low-confidence upstream evidence; the label never reaches an arithmetic operand

rules.title: Recommendation vocabulary
rules.equation: parameter canons may specialise

rules.title: Calculation and presentation are separate
rules.equation: the message layer must not recompute a dose

rules.title: Eighteen non-negotiable architectural invariants
rules.boundaries: each maps to at least one invariant here

groups.group: Part II — Shared measurement, evidence, segmentation, intervention

rules.title: Position, trajectory, consumption and potency are separate inferences
rules.equation: none may substitute for another

rules.title: Evidence is question-specific
rules.boundaries: trend-eligible does not imply potency-eligible

rules.title: No hidden data stretching
rules.equation: never reach farther back until a number can be produced

rules.title: Known interventions are not noise
rules.equation: never pretend a logged event did not occur

rules.title: Missing information differs from conflicting information
rules.boundaries: the next action differs

rules.title: Timestamps stored as unambiguous absolute instants
rules.equation: offset-aware or UTC; retain local zone for display only
rules.boundaries: required for all new V2 events

rules.title: Display rounding never enters calculations
rules.equation: 8.849 displayed as 8.8 is computed as 8.849

rules.title: Legacy timestamps without a proven absolute instant
rules.equation: exact-elapsed analysis NOT_RUN for the latter two
rules.boundaries: forbidden: assigning noon, the current timezone, or treating local HH:MM as absolute

rules.title: Event ordering at identical timestamps
rules.equation: pre-event measurement < intervention < post-event measurement; otherwise ordinal + mark ambiguous
rules.boundaries: never assume before/after if the record does not establish it

rules.title: rawValue is preserved
rules.equation: never overwritten by rounded, median, fitted or corrected values

rules.title: baseUncertainty is the engine working estimate
rules.equation: Alk: 0.10 dKH
rules.boundaries: not display resolution, not manufacturer accuracy, not a standard deviation

rules.title: User entry validation
rules.equation: finite, supported unit, physically representable, valid timestamp, parameter identity
rules.boundaries: out-of-range is NOT a validation failure

rules.title: Measurement validity states
rules.equation: a repeat that merely differs does not supersede; use a cluster
rules.boundaries: SUSPECT is not automatically INVALID

rules.title: Automatic repeat grouping
rules.equation: same parameter, compatible method, within 30 min, no intervention between
rules.boundaries: an internal data-model constant, not a Setup judgement

rules.title: Cluster representative value
rules.equation: median(raw valid member values)
rules.boundaries: even-count median convention pinned

rules.title: Cluster timestamp
rules.equation: median(member measuredAt)

rules.title: Cluster internal spread and sigma
rules.equation: sigma_cluster = max(sigma_base, 1.4826 x MAD)
rules.boundaries: never divide by sqrt(n)

rules.title: Internally inconsistent cluster
rules.equation: Alk: anomalous when max - min > 0.20 dKH
rules.boundaries: historical anomalous cluster treatment undefined

rules.title: Independent observations
rules.equation: Alk: forward-greedy from the earliest eligible cluster; accept the next candidate >= 24 h after the last ACCEPTED cluster
rules.boundaries: the anchor is the last accepted cluster, not the last candidate examined; inclusive at exactly 24 h

rules.title: Uncertainty has a lower bound
rules.equation: never claim precision finer than the configured analytical uncertainty

rules.title: Uncertainty is not position tolerance
rules.equation: a reading does not become in range because uncertainty overlaps the range

rules.title: Parameter-specific base uncertainty; never borrow
rules.equation: missing -> REFUSE uncertainty-dependent outputs only
rules.boundaries: never borrow Alk's value for another parameter

rules.title: Normalized analytical series
rules.equation: each point retains raw value, total normalization, source events, normalized value
rules.boundaries: raw values remain untouched

rules.title: Known discrete-input normalization
rules.equation: A_norm(t) = A_raw(t) - SUM_{t_j <= t} dA_j
rules.boundaries: no arbitrary 3-day linear rule

rules.title: Normalization uncertainty
rules.equation: propagate where material; parameter canons define the implementation
rules.boundaries: Alk defines no propagation

rules.title: Ongoing maintenance delivery is a rate, not a step
rules.equation: do not subtract the maintenance dose as a step from each measurement

rules.title: Exact delivered maintenance input over an interval
rules.equation: D_eff = DeliveredVolume / dDays
rules.boundaries: a mixed interval is still not automatically clean for response or potency

rules.title: Segment boundaries
rules.equation: 12 named boundary causes
rules.boundaries: not every boundary breaks every inference

rules.title: Clean trend segment requirements
rules.equation: compatible method, no unresolved hard confounder, no unmodelled step, policy permits included events, enough clusters
rules.boundaries: a dose change normally creates a boundary for post-change assessment

rules.title: Clean consumption segment requirements
rules.equation: selected potency available, delivered input known, no unaccounted exogenous input, sufficient trend evidence

rules.title: Clean potency-learning comparison
rules.equation: nine named conditions
rules.boundaries: stricter than intervention response assessment

rules.title: Confirmed consumption-context change
rules.equation: ineligible when the event falls between pre-window start and post-window end
rules.boundaries: never inferred from an unexpected slope; absence does not prove constancy

rules.title: Lookback policies may differ per inference
rules.equation: never silently extend
rules.boundaries: Alk has one 14-day lookback for trend and consumption

rules.title: Change points / confirmed discontinuities
rules.equation: a single surprising reading does not create a regime
rules.boundaries: automated detection is optional for V2 initial release

rules.title: Two independent clusters: two-point rate
rules.boundaries: evidence confidence inherently limited

rules.title: Theil-Sen intercept
rules.equation: b = median(A_i - S t_i); use a local time origin

rules.title: Residuals and robust residual scale
rules.equation: r_i = A_i - Ahat(t_i); sigma_r = 1.4826 x MAD(r_i)
rules.boundaries: MAD is blind to a lone outlier; no compensating inflation term may be added

rules.title: Canonical shared slope uncertainty
rules.equation: sigma_point = max(sigma_base, sigma_r); Sxx = SUM (t_i - tbar)^2; sigma_S = sigma_point / sqrt(Sxx)
rules.boundaries: pairwise slope MAD is diagnostic only and must not be combined via max()

rules.title: Degenerate cases
rules.equation: Sxx <= 0 -> not calculable; no zero-time pairwise slopes; duplicate times merged
rules.boundaries: if fewer than the minimum remain, INSUFFICIENT rather than a fit over fragments

rules.title: Trend output contract
rules.equation: 15 named fields
rules.boundaries: no UI surface recalculates these

rules.title: Observed movement metrics
rules.output: endpoint movement, fitted movement, direction consistency, movement SNR
rules.equation: evidence metadata, not decision thresholds

rules.title: Movement claim requires three independent clusters
rules.equation: two clusters are normally PROVISIONAL
rules.boundaries: one reading is a position, two is a signal, three can establish movement

rules.title: Rapid / safety override must be parameter-defined
rules.equation: the shared engine must not invent a generic rapid threshold

rules.title: Evidence state ordering
rules.output: CONFOUNDED > ANOMALOUS > INSUFFICIENT > PROVISIONAL > SUFFICIENT > HIGH_CONFIDENCE
rules.equation: rule-based and explainable, never a blended score
rules.boundaries: ordering is the tie-break when several apply

rules.title: Evidence diagnostics
rules.equation: 13 named fields making "why the app is waiting" mechanical

rules.title: Soft confounders
rules.output: lower confidence | exclude from potency | shorten window | require another measurement
rules.equation: parameter canon defines relevance
rules.boundaries: do not apply one universal list to every parameter

rules.title: Baseline for an intervention
rules.equation: latest valid pre-change cluster, pre-change trend, dose state, potency, target range, config version
rules.boundaries: no adequate pre-trend -> still tracked, weaker comparison

rules.title: Exposure after a dose change
rules.equation: incremental new-dose volume / incremental volume over one complete cycle
rules.boundaries: Alk supplies no minimumExposure constant

rules.title: Post-change analytical segment and the time-zero anchor
rules.equation: the anchor starts the first interval and is NOT a post-change observation
rules.boundaries: never mix older pre-change measurements into the post slope

rules.title: Too soon to tell
rules.boundaries: no dose re-adjustment merely because the level has not reached stability

rules.title: Response metrics are diagnostic only
rules.equation: must NOT become a second response classifier; do not use the ratio when dS_expected is near zero
rules.boundaries: no fixed response-ratio bands

rules.title: Intervention phase transitions
rules.equation: six named transitions

rules.title: Multiple rapid changes
rules.output: all preserved; each unevaluable becomes INTERRUPTED
rules.equation: prefer holding the latest actual dose until a clean segment exists
rules.boundaries: never pretend the history was a single jump

rules.title: Manual changes outside the wizard
rules.equation: record recommended dose, actual dose, and source separately
rules.boundaries: do not assume the user followed the recommendation

rules.title: Maintenance intervention vs return-plan intervention
rules.equation: maintenance targets S -> 0; a plan creates a controlled non-zero trajectory
rules.boundaries: consumption estimation during a plan must account for the temporary input

rules.title: Consumption-regime change vs potency discrepancy
rules.equation: only controlled repeated evidence updates potency
rules.boundaries: do not immediately choose a cause

rules.title: Water-change mixing model
rules.equation: dA_WC = f (A_replacement - A_tank)
rules.boundaries: valid only where the parameter mixes approximately linearly and replacement chemistry is known

rules.title: Water-change data confidence tiers
rules.equation: Alk normalizes only at MEASURED_SAME_BATCH; every lower tier falls through to the unknown branch
rules.boundaries: an unverified salt label never becomes a precise correction

rules.title: Water-change normalization
rules.equation: A_norm(t) = A_raw(t) - SUM_{events <= t} dA_event
rules.boundaries: all normalizations remain visible in audit data

rules.title: Suspicious-reading detection
rules.equation: Z_i = \|r_i\| / max(sigma_i, sigma_r, eps); Alk supplies no threshold and Freeze 5 declined to invent one
rules.boundaries: the three operative SUSPECT sources are explicit marking, recorded device fault and repeat spread; a reading is never silently discarded

rules.title: Latest suspicious reading behaviour
rules.equation: do not silently exclude it and act on older data
rules.boundaries: core safety behaviour

rules.title: Historical suspicious reading behaviour
rules.equation: repeat disproved it, user marked invalid, or a known fault
rules.boundaries: do not trim statistical outliers from history

rules.title: Retest candidate classes
rules.equation: earliest applicable candidate; ordinary observation clamped to [24 h, 96 h]
rules.boundaries: the 24 h floor binds ordinary observation only, never repeat-now, rapid, safety or forecast-boundary candidates

rules.title: Detectability time after a dose change
rules.equation: T_detect = K_detect x sigma_effect / |dS_expected|
rules.boundaries: Freeze 5 declined to invent K_detect; the post-change candidates of ALK-053 cover the same state

rules.title: Confidence-building time
rules.equation: T_signal = 0.10 / \|S_supported\| days; NOT_RUN when S_supported = 0
rules.boundaries: clamped to <= 96 h; no floor; it is one candidate, never the answer

rules.title: Boundary-crossing time
rules.equation: T_boundary = T_outer - 1.0 days; T_boundary <= 0 -> REPEAT_NOW
rules.boundaries: T_outer uses S_observed, never S_supported; not submitted once the level is breached

rules.title: Immediate repeat outranks normal scheduling
rules.boundaries: the repeat belongs to the same cluster unless time or an intervention separates it

rules.title: Routine cadence
rules.equation: returned only when no intervention, anomaly, risk, and evidence already sufficient
rules.boundaries: stability does not mean testing can stop

rules.title: Retest output contract
rules.equation: action, earliestUsefulAt, recommendedAt, latestSafeAt, reasonCode, candidateTimes, assumptions
rules.boundaries: user-facing copy comes later

rules.title: Response improving but not settled
rules.equation: do not finish the calculation by changing the dose again solely because the level remains outside range
rules.boundaries: especially important under stabilise-first

rules.title: Reassessment uses the post-change segment
rules.equation: based on the post-change segment, not the old segment plus the new dose

rules.title: Position during intervention
rules.equation: intervention state never overrides measured position

rules.title: Target entry while still moving
rules.equation: do not collapse "in range" into "finished"

rules.title: Deterministic replay
rules.inputs: ledger, config versions, engine/canon version, asOf
rules.equation: no randomness, no clock, no UI rounding, no iteration-order dependence
rules.boundaries: every analysis function accepts an explicit asOf

rules.title: Parameter policy contract, injected explicitly
rules.equation: never import global alkalinity constants into another parameter
rules.boundaries: ten policy groups; the maximum observation interval is supplied by ALK-053's Day-4 window; the minimum useful interval and minimumExposure remain absent
rules.finding: CANON_DEFECT (OI-EXPOSURE-001 only; scheduler fields RESOLVED F5-09)

rules.title: Failure handling
rules.inputs: missing dose history, potency, net volume; corrupt ordering; conflicting interventions
rules.equation: position and trend survive; affected inferences refuse
rules.boundaries: conflicting active interventions: do not guess, request reconciliation

rules.title: Fifteen shared property/invariant tests
rules.fixtures: INV-C1, INV-C4..C9, INV-E1, INV-E4, INV-F1, INV-H3, INV-H5, INV-A1
rules.boundaries: each mapped to an invariant here

rules.title: Three jobs of the Alk engine
rules.equation: determine position; determine whether supply matches consumption; execute a chosen return
rules.boundaries: the automatic controller targets S_desired = 0

rules.title: Canonical Alk units and conversions
rules.equation: 1 meq/L = 2.8 dKH; 1 dKH approx 0.35714 meq/L
rules.boundaries: display rounding never enters control arithmetic

rules.title: Target range and aim point
rules.equation: AimPoint = (RangeMin + RangeMax)/2; default suggestion 8.2-8.8
rules.boundaries: no separately stored ideal point; the range must lie inside the outer bounds

rules.title: Outer operating bounds 7.0-11.0 dKH
rules.equation: default envelope retained from V1 as a higher-severity internal boundary
rules.boundaries: not a claim that everything inside is safe for every coral; avoid the words safe/unsafe

rules.title: Outer-bound safety action
rules.equation: low: dA = min(A_safe_low - A_now, 0.50), V = dA / P; high: see ALK-003A high-breach limbs
rules.boundaries: strict inequality at the bound; the one explicit exception to stabilise-first

rules.title: Safety buffer is a fixed 0.20 dKH controller constant
rules.equation: B_safety = 2 x 0.10 = 0.20; A_safe_low = OuterMin + 0.20; A_safe_high = OuterMax - 0.20
rules.boundaries: never recomputed from kit, per-reading precision, residual scatter or sigma_point

rules.title: One-off safety-correction resolution exemption
rules.equation: M-1's refusal applies to maintenance mL/day; it blocks neither the one-off SAFETY_RETURN volume nor the temporary safety rate advisory
rules.boundaries: advisory rate and executable pump command are two distinct fields and never merge; the high-breach RATE is covered by ALK-SAFETY-TEMP-RATE-RESOLUTION-001

rules.title: High breach with uninterpretable consumption pauses dosing
rules.equation: A_now > OuterMax and C_estimate materially negative -> safetyDose = 0; maintenanceEstimateStatus = UNRESOLVED; retest approx 24 h
rules.boundaries: a fail-safe for an invalid model, not a claim that consumption is zero; the non-material negative band is undetermined (OI-HIGHBREACHBAND-001)

rules.title: Safety return integrates with the intervention machinery
rules.equation: maintenance deferred; prior attribution interrupted; an in-flight return plan TERMINATED; delivered correction segmented; potency confounded; owns the lock; the lock is a recommendation lock
rules.boundaries: terminated, never suspended; no automatic resume; opposing intentional components are never layered

rules.title: Alk outer-bound safety overrides the Mg alert-low hold (Option B)
rules.output: safety return allowed in all three states
rules.equation: ALERT_LOW -> allow + warn; NOT_ALERT_LOW -> allow; UNKNOWN -> allow, invent nothing
rules.boundaries: Mg data is not a required input for the Alk safety action

rules.title: Alk measurement uncertainty floor 0.10 dKH
rules.equation: working analytical uncertainty floor
rules.boundaries: 8.19 against an edge of 8.20 is below range

rules.title: Alk repeat-cluster policy and 0.20 dKH spread rule
rules.equation: 30-minute window; A_cluster = median; anomalous when max - min > 0.20
rules.boundaries: 0.20 is twice the analytical floor; an engineering judgement, not a biological limit

rules.title: Routine Alk testing cadence 48 h
rules.equation: default analytical cadence, not a prohibition on testing sooner
rules.boundaries: sooner for suspicion, rapid change, plan near destination, outer-bound excursion, troubleshooting

rules.title: Current-control lookback: most recent clean segment, capped at 14 days
rules.equation: never stretch beyond 14 days because evidence is sparse
rules.boundaries: a segment may be shorter for seven named causes

rules.title: Minimum cadence for ordinary automatic maintenance advice
rules.equation: >= 3 valid independent clusters AND >= 4-day clean span AND lookback <= 14 days
rules.boundaries: a 10-day cadence remains INSUFFICIENT by design

rules.title: Normal independent spacing
rules.equation: a cluster < 24 h after the last ACCEPTED independent cluster is not an ordinary maintenance-trend observation; selection is forward-greedy from the earliest
rules.boundaries: a rejected cluster keeps position, anomaly-confirmation, rapid and time-resolved-intervention uses; it is never marked SUSPECT or INVALID

rules.title: Alk trend estimator
rules.equation: two clusters: two-point rate; three or more: Theil-Sen
rules.boundaries: OLS may be retained diagnostically only

rules.title: Alk position is the latest valid measured cluster value
rules.equation: a fitted Alk value may not overrule it
rules.boundaries: cluster representative, not last raw reading

rules.title: One ordinary Alk movement authority
rules.equation: S_sup<0 FALLING; S_sup>0 RISING; S_sup=0 and S_obs!=0 UNCERTAINTY_LIMITED; both 0 STABLE
rules.boundaries: replaces the V1 fixed 0.10 gate plus endpoint persistence

rules.title: Canonical Alk slope uncertainty
rules.equation: sigma_point = max(0.10, 1.4826 MAD(r)); Sxx = SUM (t_i - tbar)^2; sigma_S = sigma_point / sqrt(Sxx); two-point: sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)/dt
rules.boundaries: Sxx <= 0 -> INSUFFICIENT; all-zero residuals still keep the floor

rules.title: Supported Alk slope
rules.equation: S_sup = sign(S) x max(0, |S| - 1.28 sigma_S)
rules.boundaries: never used for consumption, forecast or position; never multiplied by a confidence label

rules.title: ALK_SLOPE_SUPPORT_K = 1.28
rules.equation: fixed but reviewable engineering constant, never a Setup preference

rules.title: STABLE is a positive analytical conclusion
rules.equation: requires the ordinary minimum AND S_supported = 0 AND S_observed = 0
rules.boundaries: illustrative examples in the canon contradict the boxed condition; ALK-RETURN-ELIGIBLE-TRAJECTORY-001 is a separate, weaker predicate and does not widen STABLE

rules.title: Rapid-change override
rules.equation: \|S_pair\| >= 0.30 dKH/day on the latest independent pair with >= 24 h between representative times, plus four conditions
rules.boundaries: S_pair is a test statistic only; sizing, consumption and forecasting keep S_observed

rules.title: Theoretical alkalinity potency
rules.boundaries: 101 g/L in 77 L gives approx 0.0693 dKH/mL as a validation example, not a default

rules.title: One selected potency
rules.equation: theoretical before calibration; learned after
rules.boundaries: the recommendation engine must not keep a second private estimate

rules.title: Potency observation
rules.inputs: clean pre/post slopes and delivered dose states
rules.equation: P_i = (S_post - S_pre) / (D_post - D_pre)
rules.boundaries: every observation is an inference with confidence, not a bottle assay

rules.title: Alk potency-learning qualification
rules.equation: nine conditions; >=3 clusters and >=4-day span per side; SNR = |dS| / sqrt(sigma_pre^2 + sigma_post^2); <2.0 ineligible, 2.0-3.0 diagnostic, >=3.0 calibration-eligible
rules.boundaries: minimum per-side evidence needs |dD| >= 2.1645 mL/day at P = 0.0693 for calibration eligibility

rules.title: Potency observation plausibility envelope
rules.equation: 0.40 P_expected <= P_i <= 1.60 P_expected; P_i <= 0 rejected
rules.boundaries: two recent outside-envelope observations in the same direction trigger verification, not learning

rules.title: Pooling Alk potency observations
rules.inputs: eligible observations in one exact context
rules.equation: P_learned = median(P_i); RDisp_P = 1.4826 MAD_P / P_learned
rules.boundaries: no quality adjective, recency judgement or hidden weight

rules.title: Potency confidence ladder
rules.equation: CALIBRATED: >=3 obs, >=2 interventions, >=7 days, RDisp <= 0.15; STRONG: >=5, >=3, 2 magnitudes, >=14 days, RDisp <= 0.10; REASSESSING on two consecutive >15% same-direction deltas
rules.boundaries: partition not exhaustive; REASSESSING has no exit

rules.title: Potency discrepancy wording bands
rules.equation: 0.85-1.15 consistent; 0.70-0.85 or 1.15-1.30 meaningful; <0.70 or >1.30 large
rules.boundaries: report effective delivered potency, never a definitive reservoir concentration

rules.title: Current consumption best estimate
rules.equation: C = P_selected D - S_observed, using the OBSERVED slope
rules.boundaries: never substitute S_supported to be conservative

rules.title: Best-estimate demand versus recommended actuator dose
rules.equation: maintenanceEstimate = C/P; continuousActionCandidate = D_current - S_supported/P
rules.boundaries: the two must never share one field named maintenanceDose

rules.title: Stable below or above range holds maintenance
rules.equation: while inside the outer envelope, an out-of-range level with returnPlanEligibleTrajectory never changes maintenance
rules.boundaries: one of the most important retained V1 principles

rules.title: Below range and falling
rules.equation: addresses the maintenance deficit only
rules.boundaries: never silently adds a return-to-range component

rules.title: In range and falling
rules.equation: do not wait for the level to leave range if the imbalance is already supported
rules.boundaries: retest timing may shorten

rules.title: Above range and rising
rules.equation: mirror of ALK-025; seeks stability, not a deliberate fall into range
rules.boundaries: negative inferred consumption is handled separately

rules.title: In range and rising
rules.boundaries: do not call a rising level fine merely because it has not crossed the upper edge

rules.title: Below range and already rising
rules.output: HOLD when the rise is supported and no plan is active
rules.equation: below range + supported RISING -> HOLD; still determine dose-vs-estimate and forecast range entry, but do not act on them
rules.boundaries: requires a SUPPORTED trajectory; UNCERTAINTY_LIMITED is held by ALK-011 instead

rules.title: Above range and already falling
rules.output: HOLD when the fall is supported and no plan is active
rules.equation: mirror of ALK-029: above range + supported FALLING -> HOLD
rules.boundaries: symmetric with ALK-029 by requirement, not by coincidence

rules.title: Negative inferred consumption
rules.equation: materially negative iff C_estimate + 1.28 x sigma_S < 0 (strict); no sigma_P and no sigma_D
rules.boundaries: HOLD on both branches; both are uninterpretable, so both arm the high-breach zero-dose fail-safe

rules.title: Broken mass balance cannot size maintenance
rules.equation: never change established maintenance from that arithmetic even if high and rising
rules.boundaries: never clamp to zero and treat zero as a real target

rules.title: Empirical dose bracket
rules.equation: advisory only: warn, lower confidence, request verification
rules.boundaries: never a hard clamp; never a silent veto

rules.title: Historical-demand comparability diagnostic
rules.equation: R_C = |C_hist - C_estimate| / C_estimate; <= 0.25 may narrow
rules.boundaries: do not use the ratio at all if current consumption is zero, negative or uninterpretable

rules.title: Alk water changes
rules.equation: material when |dA_WC| >= 0.10 dKH
rules.boundaries: normalization requires MEASURED_SAME_BATCH; every lower tier uses the unknown branch

rules.title: Unknown replacement-water Alk
rules.equation: assumed mismatch 2.0 dKH; f x 2.0 >= 0.10 at f >= 0.05; < 5% retain, >= 5% hard boundary
rules.boundaries: never a back-door subtraction rule

rules.title: Known Alk corrections
rules.equation: A_norm(t) = A_raw(t) - SUM dA_j for t_j <= t
rules.boundaries: the V1 three-day linear assumption is removed

rules.title: Actual hourly dosing and dose changes
rules.equation: a setting changed at 14:30 has not delivered a full day's difference by 15:00
rules.boundaries: matters most in the first 24 h, missed doses, interruptions and potency learning

rules.title: First post-change check at approx 48 h
rules.equation: Day 2 does NOT run the formal causal classifier
rules.boundaries: must not call an approximately flat first interval "no response"

rules.title: Second post-change test around Day 4
rules.equation: preferred point for confirming the new dose and considering potency eligibility
rules.boundaries: its "routine second maintenance adjustment" conflicts with the evidence minimum

rules.title: Expected Alk response
rules.equation: dS_expected = P (D_new - D_old)
rules.boundaries: still falling at the predicted rate is expected, not failure

rules.title: No detectable response requires formal detectability
rules.equation: inside the band around zero AND outside the band around the expected response
rules.boundaries: a Day +2 baseline-to-first-reading interval is never sufficient

rules.title: Contradictory response
rules.equation: the app reports the contradiction and claims no cause
rules.boundaries: may justify earlier retesting and delivery verification

rules.title: Partial response
rules.equation: hold while evidence develops; recalculate once sufficient

rules.title: Over-response
rules.equation: use the current post-change state
rules.boundaries: do not automatically reverse the entire prior change

rules.title: Overshoot is measured from the latest actual reading
rules.equation: range 8.2-8.8 with latest 8.95 is overshoot even if the fitted line is 8.78
rules.boundaries: no horizon and no return-plan boundary rule is given

rules.title: Maintenance recommendation calculation
rules.equation: dD_supported = -S_supported / P_selected; D_ideal = D_current + dD_supported
rules.boundaries: the V1 12% dose-gap trigger is removed

rules.title: Minimum useful dose change
rules.equation: |dD| >= actuator increment after continuous constraints; if rounding returns to current, HOLD
rules.boundaries: no second must-be-visible-in-48h gate

rules.title: Alkalinity rate rail 0.50 dKH/day
rules.equation: |P_selected x dD| <= 0.50 dKH/day
rules.boundaries: a ceiling, not a target

rules.title: Composite movement rail
rules.equation: |SUM dA_24h| <= 0.50; safety first, maintenance deferred not partially applied
rules.boundaries: no reachable multi-term case in the Alk-only runtime

rules.title: Ordinary 25% / exceptional 50% dose-step cap
rules.equation: cap active only when D_current >= 4 R_pump; 50% requires rapid AND actual-or-forecast outer-bound risk before the next ordinary 48 h test
rules.boundaries: being outside the preferred range never unlocks 50%

rules.title: No percentage staging layer
rules.equation: no 100/90/70/55% bands; no HIGH=100%/MODERATE=75% coefficient; no user-adjustable damping
rules.boundaries: conservatism comes only from S_supported

rules.title: Actuator rounding
rules.equation: nearest; exact tie toward current; still tied choose lower; recheck hard constraints; step toward current until feasible; else HOLD
rules.boundaries: never force a one-increment change to avoid HOLD; step 6 rechecks the rate rail and the liquid-volume guard

rules.title: Predicted post-change slope uses the final recommended dose
rules.equation: S_pred_post = S_observed + P_selected x dD_final
rules.boundaries: never assume zero

rules.title: Rounding order
rules.equation: evidence, supported candidate, no staging, rail, step cap, bracket, non-negative, liquid guard on the continuous candidate, rounding with the post-discretisation recheck, recompute, composite-rail assertion
rules.boundaries: the composite rail is a post-assembly assertion; the liquid guard is rechecked inside ALK-ROUNDING-001 step 6
rules.finding: CANON_DEFECT (minor; guard position RESOLVED F5-06, composite-rail position still derived)

rules.title: Retest scheduler: suspicious reading
rules.equation: no ordinary dose change from the suspect value
rules.boundaries: driven by the three operative SUSPECT sources; automatic statistical detection is canonically NOT_RUN

rules.title: Retest scheduler: rapid movement (approx 24 h)
rules.equation: sooner near an outer bound if safety logic requires
rules.boundaries: produced through the shared scheduler, never hardcoded in message text

rules.title: Retest after a maintenance change
rules.equation: may shorten on rapid, outer-bound risk, suspicion, contradiction, earlier detectability or a safety rule
rules.boundaries: preserve the approx 48 h human rhythm; avoid spurious precision

rules.title: Return plan arithmetic
rules.inputs: aim point, plan slope, potency, maintenance reference
rules.equation: offer iff returnPlanEligibleTrajectory; D_temp = D_maintenance_reference + S_plan / P_selected, clamped >= 0
rules.boundaries: eligibility is ordinary minimum evidence AND S_supported = 0; it is not ALK-STABLE-001

rules.title: Return-plan pace choices
rules.equation: Gentle 0.125, Steady 0.25, Quick 0.50 dKH/day = 25/50/100% of the rail
rules.boundaries: downward pace additionally limited by consumption and the zero-dose floor

rules.title: Return-plan completion
rules.equation: stop on the FIRST measured reach or pass; confirmation is a separate stage
rules.boundaries: never keep the temporary dose running while awaiting confirmation

rules.title: Return-plan arrival zone
rules.equation: zoneWidth = max(bandWidth/3, 2 sigma_Alk) clamped to band width, centred on the midpoint
rules.boundaries: for 8.2-8.8 the zone is 8.4-8.6

rules.title: Return-plan expiry
rules.equation: T_expiry = 2 T_plan + 2 days from actual implemented start
rules.boundaries: never set the actual dose state to stopped merely because stopping was recommended

rules.title: Corrections as an execution mechanism
rules.equation: opted into, known potency and volume, rail-respecting, logged as actual input, normalized appropriately
rules.boundaries: correction and return plan must not compete as two unrelated answers

rules.title: One-off correction formula
rules.equation: Dose_mL = dA / P_selected
rules.boundaries: full precision, rail, liquid guard, round last, log actual delivered

rules.title: Gross liquid-volume sanity guard
rules.equation: V_max_24h = 0.02 x 1000 x V_L, over ALL engine-generated Alk delivery and their combined 24 h total
rules.boundaries: binds on the continuous candidate (ALK-049 step 8) AND after discretisation (ALK-ROUNDING-001 step 6); exceeding WITHHOLDS; never cap to the guard nor emit a command equal to it

rules.title: Forecasting uses the observed slope
rules.equation: preferred-range and outer-bound limbs; irrelevant direction is NOT_APPLICABLE, never negative
rules.boundaries: never forecast risk from S_supported

rules.title: Dose change plus target entry
rules.equation: stabilising consumption while remaining out of range is not failure

rules.title: Dose change carries the level into range while still moving
rules.equation: do not declare success merely because position is in range
rules.boundaries: automatic advice still seeks zero slope

rules.title: Backdated / edited data
rules.equation: rebuild affected derived analyses forward; never rewrite historical advice

rules.title: Target-range change
rules.equation: does not alter values, consumption, potency or prior recommendations
rules.boundaries: a target edit is not a biological demand event

rules.title: Solution batch / concentration change
rules.equation: recompute theoretical potency; do not carry the old learned value
rules.boundaries: old ratio is weak contextual prior only where justified

rules.title: Pump calibration / delivery change
rules.equation: tank response measures effective delivery, not bottle chemistry alone
rules.boundaries: never pool across the boundary

rules.title: Canonical slope / demand / dose variable semantics
rules.equation: observedSlope, slopeUncertainty, supportedSlope, consumptionEstimate, maintenanceEstimate, continuousActionCandidate, recommendedDose, predictedPostSlope
rules.boundaries: no generic field named slope, consumption or maintenanceDose

rules.title: Core recommendation matrix
rules.equation: nine position/trajectory cells plus four override rows; the Below+Rising and Above+Falling cells resolve to HOLD under ALK-TOWARD-RANGE-HOLD-001
rules.boundaries: the two toward-range cells require a supported trajectory; the in-range rows are unchanged

rules.title: Confidence is output, never a dose multiplier
rules.output: UNSPECIFIED plus the underlying evidence facts
rules.equation: dose sizing runs S_observed -> sigma_S -> S_supported -> dD, then constraints; the label is UNSPECIFIED and never an operand
rules.boundaries: no numeric LOW/MODERATE/HIGH classification exists and none may be invented

rules.title: Twelve V1 behaviours explicitly removed
rules.boundaries: each removed behaviour maps to a prohibition test

rules.title: Pre-change evidence required for causal attribution
rules.equation: rapid basis may use sigma_pre = sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)/dt
rules.boundaries: terminal for that intervention's attribution only

rules.title: Formal maintenance-intervention response classifier
rules.equation: u = sign(dS_exp); R_obs = u (S_post - S_pre); B = 1.28 sqrt(sigma_pre^2 + sigma_post^2); five boxed conditions plus INCONCLUSIVE
rules.boundaries: R_obs = -B exactly is NO_DETECTABLE_RESPONSE (finding D-7 retained)

rules.title: Attribution may be impossible while maintenance stays assessable
rules.equation: B_min = 1.28 sigma_pre; R_exp <= B_min is terminal
rules.boundaries: at 3-cluster pre-evidence the minimum attributable change is 0.6530 mL/day at P = 0.0693

rules.title: Awaiting response detectability
rules.equation: sigma_post_required = sqrt((R_exp/1.28)^2 - sigma_pre^2); 14-day maximum attribution horizon
rules.boundaries: neither failure nor NO_DETECTABLE_RESPONSE

rules.title: Small-signal attribution card is mandatory
rules.equation: lead with the operational conclusion, not the statistical limitation
rules.boundaries: collapsed summaries must not contradict the full card

rules.title: Dose changes made outside the app
rules.equation: known time -> re-segment; uncertain time -> CONFOUNDED; discovered wrong dose -> correct forward; no evidence -> never infer
rules.boundaries: never invent a dose event to make the mathematics fit

rules.title: Intervention prediction is immutable
rules.equation: 12 required fields; the classifier always evaluates against dS_expected,0
rules.boundaries: prevents moving goalposts and circular self-validation

rules.title: App capability and degradation contract
rules.equation: no implementation may silently manufacture a missing input
rules.fixtures: WG-ALK-045..048, WG-ALK-054, WG-ALK-061, WG-ALK-065, WG-ALK-066, INV-G6
rules.boundaries: every required datum needs a capture source, a stored representation and a defined missing behaviour

rules.title: Empirical potency learning is capability-gated
rules.equation: default OFF until all exist; core controller runs on theoretical potency
rules.boundaries: a capability deferral, not a retreat from the learner design

rules.title: Forward-greedy independent-cluster selection
rules.equation: accept the earliest eligible cluster; accept the next candidate >= 24 h after the LAST ACCEPTED cluster; a rejected candidate never becomes the anchor; identical representative timestamps are undetermined
rules.boundaries: inclusive at exactly 24 h; APPENDED data never changes an earlier acceptance, backdated-earlier data may; backward-greedy and keep-all-and-mark are forbidden
rules.finding: NO_PROBLEM (RESOLVED F5-01); tie case OI-CLUSTERTIE-001 open

rules.title: Suspicious-reading detection basis
rules.inputs: readings, user marks, device-fault events, repeat spread
rules.equation: automatic statistical detection = NOT_RUN; the operative sources are explicit user marking, a recorded test/device fault and the ALK-005 0.20 dKH repeat spread
rules.boundaries: an unusual reading may prompt a repeat but is never silently discarded; no Z threshold from another parameter, V1 or convention; no compensating uncertainty inflation

rules.title: Materially-negative consumption boundary
rules.equation: materiallyNegative iff C_estimate + 1.28 x sigma_S < 0 (strict)
rules.boundaries: HOLD on both branches; the material branch arms the high-breach fail-safe, the non-material branch's high-breach status is undetermined (OI-HIGHBREACHBAND-001)
rules.finding: NO_PROBLEM (RESOLVED F5-03); high-breach band OI-HIGHBREACHBAND-001 open

rules.title: Return-plan trajectory eligibility predicate
rules.equation: ordinary minimum evidence satisfied AND S_supported = 0, i.e. trajectory in { STABLE, UNCERTAINTY_LIMITED }
rules.boundaries: distinct from and weaker than ALK-STABLE-001, which is unchanged; INSUFFICIENT evidence is not eligible; the offer stays opt-in

rules.title: Automatic maintenance does not oppose a supported trajectory toward range
rules.equation: below range + supported RISING -> HOLD; above range + supported FALLING -> HOLD
rules.boundaries: requires a SUPPORTED trajectory; does not suspend ALK-OUTER-BOUND-ACTION-001, ALK-RAPID-001, the retest scheduler, the active-plan branches or the in-range rows

rules.title: Rapid basis is the latest independent pair
rules.inputs: the last two accepted independent clusters
rules.equation: S_rapid = (A_latest - A_previous_candidate_at_least_24h_earlier) / dt_days
rules.boundaries: drawn from CANDIDATE clusters, not only accepted ones - ALK-008 grants a non-accepted cluster this use; S_rapid is a test statistic only

rules.title: Entering SAFETY_RETURN terminates an active return plan
rules.equation: terminate immediately; recommendedTemporaryMovement = STOP_PENDING_USER_ACTION; actualDose = last logged or UNKNOWN
rules.boundaries: never suspended; no automatic resume; a new plan needs fresh eligibility and a fresh opt-in; the plan's identity and stored fields survive

rules.title: Canonical Alk retest scheduler
rules.equation: earliest applicable candidate; T_signal = 0.10 / |S_supported|; T_boundary = T_outer - 1.0 d; ordinary observation clamped to <= 96 h; no floor
rules.reasonCodes: RETEST_SIGNAL_ACCUMULATION, RETEST_FORECAST_BOUNDARY_RISK, RETEST_OBSERVATION_CEILING_APPLIED, RETEST_MINIMUM_INTERVAL_UNAVAILABLE, RETEST_DETECTABILITY_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE, RETEST_RETURN_PLAN_CADENCE_UNAVAILABLE
rules.fixtures: AD-RET-001, AD-RET-002, AD-RET-003, AD-RET-004, AD-RET-005, WG-ALK-060
rules.boundaries: one scheduler only; no minimum useful interval; T_outer uses S_observed; the forecast candidate stands down once breached; tied candidates all emit their codes
rules.dependencies: PII-51, PII-53, PII-54, PII-66, ALK-050, ALK-052, ALK-POSTCHANGE-RETEST-001, ALK-062, X-INV-004
rules.finding: NO_PROBLEM (RESOLVED F5-09); scheduler floor OI-RETESTFLOOR-001 open

rules.title: Only MEASURED_SAME_BATCH normalizes a water change
rules.equation: normalizationPermitted iff confidence = MEASURED_SAME_BATCH; every lower tier falls through to ALK-WATERCHANGE-UNKNOWN-001
rules.boundaries: an unverified salt label never becomes a precise correction; the stated value is still retained for audit

rules.title: Temporary high-breach safety rate is advisory-emittable
rules.output: advisory rate and, separately, an executable pump command
rules.equation: advisory rate = exact D_safety_temp; executable pump command = NOT_RUN while the increment is unavailable
rules.boundaries: two distinct fields that never merge; no invented increment; potency stays load-bearing; all rails and guards still apply

groups.group: Capability contract, Part IX surfaces, Part X migration & governance

rules.title: Actuator increment
rules.equation: smallest maintenance-dose change the keeper can reliably implement
rules.boundaries: no hidden 0.1 default; one-off SAFETY_RETURN volume is exempt; the high-breach RATE is unaddressed

rules.title: Solution concentration / potency context
rules.equation: core continues on validated configured potency
rules.boundaries: no observations pooled across an unknown context; lot number optional, continuity is not

rules.title: Delivery / pump configuration context
rules.equation: core continues from a user-confirmed programmed dose
rules.boundaries: the app need not know every mechanical detail, only whether the relevant context changed

rules.title: Replacement-water alkalinity
rules.equation: apply ALK-WATERCHANGE-UNKNOWN-001 exactly
rules.boundaries: the engine does not refuse ordinary Alk use merely because this is absent

rules.title: Dose-change effective time / late entry
rules.equation: uncertain time -> NOT_ASSESSABLE_UNKNOWN_CHANGE_TIME, potency ineligible
rules.boundaries: recordedAt must never be equated with effectiveAt for a late external entry

rules.title: Delivered volume versus programmed schedule
rules.equation: telemetry is NOT required; confirmed programmed schedule suffices for a clean constant-dose regime
rules.boundaries: mixed intervals without an eligible basis segment instead

rules.title: Immutable intervention prediction snapshot
rules.equation: required schema dependency for new V2 interventions
rules.boundaries: the current post-intervention regime may still be analysed

rules.title: Precise measurement time / repeat clusters
rules.equation: legacy imprecise readings support position and history but not exact trend points
rules.boundaries: measuredAt is the biological sampling time

rules.title: Pre/post programmed dose states for potency
rules.equation: P_i uses programmed rates, not laboratory pump output
rules.boundaries: calibrates effective effect per programmed mL including stable systematic bias

rules.title: Historical empirical-bracket evidence
rules.equation: empiricalBracketStatus = UNAVAILABLE; core control continues
rules.boundaries: no bracket reconstructed from incomplete snapshots

rules.title: Magnesium alert-state interface
rules.equation: Alk safety return remains eligible; no low-Mg warning invented
rules.boundaries: Mg state is advisory for this override, not a prerequisite

rules.title: Effective-dated configuration history
rules.equation: legacy current settings seed the first V2 version effective AT migration
rules.boundaries: never backfill target range, volume, potency or resolution

rules.title: Absolute event time / timezone provenance
rules.equation: exact elapsed-time analyses NOT_RUN where ambiguity matters
rules.boundaries: no noon or current-timezone backfill

rules.title: Seven global wording rules
rules.equation: conclusion first; no first person; dose only when relevant; units always; no unsupported causal speculation; intervention precedence; no redundant parameter naming
rules.boundaries: behavioural acceptance rules, not optional style

rules.title: Evidence claims may not outrun the engine
rules.equation: "early readings are moving in the expected direction" is allowed at Day +2; "the dose change is working" is not
rules.boundaries: an intentional V2 change from V1's earlier Day-2 wording

rules.title: Small-signal attribution wording
rules.equation: hold branch: "Hold the current dose"; residual branch: "Alkalinity is falling on the current dose"
rules.boundaries: do not headline the statistical limitation; "still falling" forbidden

rules.title: Recommendation is not implementation
rules.equation: say what is recommended, never what has physically occurred
rules.boundaries: history stores recommendation, user-confirmed implementation and verified state separately

rules.title: Unresolved prior guidance is not a punitive lockout
rules.equation: name what is unresolved, its effect, and what to do now; no shaming, no refusal of valid current advice
rules.boundaries: never imply implementation occurred; never collapse unknown into non-adherence

rules.title: Insufficient-data wording must be actionable
rules.equation: say what is missing, when the next useful test is, and what can still be concluded
rules.boundaries: never a dead-end label

rules.title: Outer-bound wording register
rules.equation: distinct register; shows value, buffered destination, temporary action, separate maintenance conclusion, next test
rules.boundaries: never the words safe or unsafe

rules.title: Simulation responsibility boundary
rules.equation: classify before adding a rule
rules.boundaries: these are not interchangeable

rules.title: First V2 runtime is alkalinity-only
rules.equation: Alk advisory ACTIVE; Ca and Mg controller NONE
rules.boundaries: no V1 Ca/Mg runtime beside V2 Alk

rules.title: Ca and Mg are recorded facts only
rules.equation: no trend, evidence, uncertainty, consumption, potency, maintenance, plan, intervention, schedule, notification, card or gate state
rules.boundaries: measurement logging must not become an undeclared controller

rules.title: Magnesium gate isolation
rules.equation: a raw Mg reading must not become ALERT_LOW or NOT_ALERT_LOW
rules.boundaries: until the Mg/coupling canon defines threshold, validity, freshness and ownership

rules.title: Confirmed ignored recommendation: reassess and continue
rules.equation: punitiveLockout = false
rules.boundaries: never refuse current advice solely because prior advice was ignored

rules.title: Unknown implementation retains evidence guards
rules.equation: never assume the dose was or was not changed
rules.boundaries: current position may still be reported

rules.title: Inform and proceed versus refuse
rules.output: proceed or withhold the affected output
rules.equation: Case A: low Mg + Alk breach -> proceed with a warning; Case B: unknown potency -> state dKH, withhold mL
rules.boundaries: never guess an mL dose

rules.title: Repeated ignored guidance is a stress test
rules.equation: deterministic, valid state, rails preserved, recommendation-vs-implementation truth, best current advice
rules.boundaries: a new rescue state is not automatically required

rules.title: Ten named canonical invariants
rules.fixtures: INV-CANON-001, INV-CORE-ADVISORY-001, INV-NONADHERENCE-001, INV-CORE-OWNER-001, INV-SURFACE-WORDING-001, INV-CONFIG-001, INV-TIME-001, INV-ALK-STAGING-001, INV-ALK-VARIABLES-001, INV-ALK-CONFIDENCE-001
rules.boundaries: each has a named coverage fixture in the canon manifest
